feeds.title: 5 Magazine » Techno
feeds.description: 5 Magazine is an electronic music publication and platform founded in Chicago. We cover house music, techno, disco, garage, and all forms of underground electronic music. Founded in 2005 by Czarina Mirani, 5 Magazine has published nearly 200 issues over the last sixteen years. For the first eleven years, each issue of 5 Magazine was distributed in print all over the city of Chicago in a print run of 10,000 copies per issue. These were given away for free in a grassroots effort to unify Chicago's music scene and bring great music to light.
